description: This file is responsible for generating and writing an official channel catalog JSON file based on package.json files found within an 'extensions' directory. It scans subdirectories, extracts channel-related information from their package.json metadata, and produces a sorted catalog of channels with associated install instructions.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Builds a catalog of channels by scanning 'extensions' subdirectories, reading their package.json files, and extracting relevant openclaw metadata.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Generates the channel catalog and writes it to a file 'dist/channel-catalog.json' using a helper function to write files only if changed.
